Background

Who I am

I’m a Business Analytics professional based in Chicago, IL — originally from Mumbai, India, where I completed my Bachelor of Electronics Engineering before building 3+ years of hands-on experience across operations, IT, and data analytics.

In 2024, I moved to the United States to pursue a Master’s in Business Analytics at DePaul University, graduating with a 3.89 GPA and the Dean’s Excellence Scholarship. During my studies, I completed an internship at Becker’s Healthcare where I built campaign analytics dashboards and supported AI-driven workflow automation.

I specialize in bridging the gap between raw data and real business decisions. Whether it’s a KPI dashboard for leadership, an ETL pipeline in Snowflake, or a Python automation script — I focus on why the numbers matter, not just what they show.

Featured Work

Projects

Plant Co. · Power BI

Plant Co. Performance Dashboard

An interactive multi-page Power BI dashboard built to analyze Plant Co.’s sales performance, gross profitability, and quantity trends across countries, products, and customer accounts — with year-over-year comparison against prior year targets.

Leadership can switch dynamically between Gross Profit, Quantity, and Sales views across 2023–2024, with automatic YTD vs PYTD variance calculations and bottom-10 country identification.
